battle.name: 第三次米特拉達梯戰爭
battle.theater: 卡帕多細亞提格拉諾刻達
battle.brief: 公元前74年，龐提翁王米特拉達梯六世越過哈里斯河侵入比提尼亞行省，第三次米特拉達梯戰爭爆發；盧庫路斯接掌遠征，前69年九月在卡帕多細亞的提格拉諾刻達，以軍團重步兵配合色雷斯與高盧騎兵擊敗梯格拉斯大帝的亞美尼亞聯軍。卡面羅馬重步兵即本役中堅，重盾短劍之外，勝負仍繫於兵源與補給。

kit.name: 羅馬重步兵
kit.history: 分段鎧甲配重盾。羅馬的戰力靠的是補充兵源與補給線，不是靠重裝。

countries: 第三次米特拉達梯戰爭是羅馬共和國對龐提翁王國的第三次大規模戰爭，自公元前74年開打，到前63年龐培迫使梯格拉斯出降為止，前後約十一年。羅馬一方由元老院發令：公元前74年以執政官盧庫路斯的名義頒布特別委任，戰區由比提尼亞行省擴為龐提翁、卡帕多細亞與亞美尼亞構成的廣大內陸，遠征軍的指揮權先後由盧庫路斯與前67年接手的龐培掌握；龐培在戰區自行任命部將與城市守將，把城邑直接交給部將經營，羅馬的「元老院授權、將軍自主」模式在這一役走到極端。遠征軍以公民兵制的軍團為骨幹，配以色雷斯、高盧、克里特等外族雇傭兵與各類騎兵，盟友則包括比提尼亞國王、卡帕多細亞國王阿里阿拉忒六世，以及被龐提翁逐出本都的科爾基斯與博斯波魯斯諸城。米特拉達梯一方是龐提翁王國本身：國王米特拉達梯六世以希臘雇傭兵組成的方陣為步兵核心，另有卡帕多細亞騎兵、斯基泰弓騎手，以及亞美尼亞王梯格拉斯的聯軍；梯格拉斯治下的亞美尼亞王國已囊括小亞細亞東部、敘利亞、腓尼基與中亞的巴克特里亞等地，是羅馬在東方最成形的一個對手。
countriesEn: The Third Mithridatic War was the third large-scale conflict between the Roman Republic and the kingdom of Pontus, running from 74 BC to 63 BC, when Pompey forced Tigranes to surrender, a matter of roughly eleven years in all. On the Roman side the Senate gave the orders: in 74 BC, on the motion of the consul Lucullus, an extraordinary command was voted, and the theatre of operations grew from the province of Bithynia into a broad inland arc running through Pontus, Cappadocia and Armenia. The command of the expedition passed first to Lucullus and then, in 67 BC, to Pompey, who in the field appointed his own legates and handed individual cities to his subordinates to administer, carrying the Roman formula of senatorial authorisation and general discretion to an extreme. The backbone of the expedition was the citizen legion, supplemented by Thracian, Galatian and Cretan mercenaries and by cavalry of several kinds, while its allies included the king of Bithynia, the king of Cappadocia Ariarathes VI, and the Greek cities of Colchis and the Bosporus that Pontus had driven out. On Mithridates' side stood the kingdom of Pontus itself: the king, Mithridates VI, built his infantry core out of Greek mercenary phalanxes, with Cappadocian cavalry, Scythian mounted archers, and the coalition of the Armenian king Tigranes. The Armenian kingdom under Tigranes already embraced eastern Asia Minor, Syria, Phoenicia and Bactria in Central Asia, and was the most fully formed opponent Rome had ever faced in the east.
people: 決定這場戰爭走向的有兩條線索。龐提翁王米特拉達梯六世是希臘化時期最積極的君主之一：他以黑海海運與徵稅養活軍隊，收編希臘流亡者與雇傭兵建立方陣，娶亞美尼亞王梯格拉斯之女為妻，把兩個王國綁成一個東方聯盟；他在宮廷中不斷清洗可能通敵的貴族，前72年甚至處死主張議和的狄昂。另一頭是羅馬將軍盧庫路斯：他把遠征當成長期工程，以每日約三十羅馬里的行軍速率、逐夜設營與嚴格的補給紀律維持軍隊的穿透力，在沒有海路可通的卡帕多細亞高原上以寒季強行追擊，終於前69年九月在提格拉諾刻達擊敗梯格拉斯的大軍。但盧庫路斯的勝利沒有帶來相稱的政治回報：他的部將與士兵就戰利品分配指控他貪墨，前66年西塞羅還在元老院為他辯護；前67年元老院換用龐培，多年戰果被重新分配，盧庫路斯本人隨即被召回。梯格拉斯是最能左右局勢而最不自知的一方：他輕信龐培會照顧他的一切安排，直到前63年才在龐培面前放下王冠；他的幼子小提格拉斯在前67年澤拉陣前倒戈，使父親最後的野戰部隊當場瓦解。米特拉達梯諸子中，馬哈瑞斯在博斯波魯斯弒父自立，菲爾納克斯與基諾斯隨父東奔西走，這些家事最終把米特拉達梯推向絕路。
peopleEn: Two threads of decision run through this war. Mithridates VI of Pontus was among the most active monarchs of the Hellenistic age: he kept an army alive with Black Sea shipping and taxation, absorbed Greek exiles and mercenaries to build his phalanxes, married a daughter of the Armenian king Tigranes and so bound two kingdoms into a single eastern alliance; at court he purged the nobility he suspected of collusion, and in 72 BC he had Dion executed for proposing terms of peace. The other thread is the Roman general Lucullus, who treated the expedition as a long engineering project, sustaining the striking power of his army by a marching rate of about thirty Roman miles a day, by a camp pitched every night and by strict discipline of supply, and who forced a winter pursuit across the high plateau of Cappadocia, a region with no access to the sea, until in September 69 BC he defeated Tigranes' great army at Tigranocerta. But Lucullus's victories brought no matching political return: his officers and men accused him of keeping the booty, and Cicero defended him in the Senate in 66 BC; in 67 BC the Senate switched to Pompey, the results of years of campaigning were redistributed, and Lucullus was recalled. Tigranes was the party who could shape the outcome most and understood it least: he trusted Pompey's assurance that everything would continue as before, and only in 63 BC did he lay down his crown before Pompey; his younger son, the younger Tigranes, defected in front of the line at Zela in 67 BC, and the last field army of his father dissolved on the spot. Among Mithridates' sons, Machares killed his father and seized the Bosporus, while Pharnaces and Hypsicrates followed their father's fortunes across the east; these family feuds finally drove Mithridates to the end of his road.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬重步兵屬羅馬共和國晚期軍團的制式重裝步兵，設計年份定於公元前100年，確實早於本役。須說明的是，卡面畫的分段鎧甲其實是公元一世紀以後的形制：前74至前63年的羅馬軍團兵穿的是鎖子甲與鱗甲，軍官另有胸甲；不變的是其餘裝備，包括橢圓或半圓柱形重盾、配重銅芯的重標槍、短劍、匕首、皮靴與草鞋、皮帶，以及每夜構築的野戰營帳。軍制上，共和末期的軍團已由百人隊改為中隊，每中隊約八百人，十中隊為一軍團，作戰時排成三列縱隊，矛兵、青年兵與老兵搭配使用，輕步兵散佈在最前。敵我裝備的對比非常鮮明：龐提翁一方的希臘雇傭兵方陣用長槍對付羅馬的短劍兵，只有靠嚴整陣形與多面包抄才能彌補；亞美尼亞輕步兵持柳條盾，善守險隘；色雷斯與高盧騎兵用小圓盾與長矛作戰，衝鋒兇猛而難以被正面阻擋。攻城與後勤器械方面，本役見得到的有海上封鎖（比提尼亞的卡爾刻冬與龐提翁的辛諾佩）、跨越幼發拉底河的浮橋與羅馬軍團的野戰營帳，後勤載具則是穆勒馱隊，而正是這些穆勒，成為米特拉達梯輕騎反覆打擊的目標。
kitsEn: The Roman legionary on the card belongs to the standard heavy infantry of the late Republican legion, its design dated to 100 BC, comfortably earlier than this war. One point must be made clear: the banded plate armour shown on the card is in fact a form that only appears after the first century AD. The legionaries of 74 to 63 BC wore mail and scale armour, with officers in addition having a breastplate. Everything else in the equipment was the same: the oval or half-cylindrical heavy shield, the heavy javelin with a bronze shank, the short sword, the sidearm, the boots and sandals, the belt, and the field camp built every night. In terms of organisation the late Republican legion had replaced the maniple with the cohort, each cohort of about eight hundred men, ten cohorts to a legion, fighting in a triple line with spearmen, young men and veterans used in combination and skirmishers ranged in front. The contrast between the two sides' equipment is sharp: the Greek mercenary phalanx of Pontus met the Roman short swords with long pikes and could only make up for the difference by strict formation and attacks from several quarters at once; Armenian light infantry carried wicker shields and were at their best holding difficult ground; Thracian and Galatian cavalry fought with small round shields and long spears, charging savagely and being hard to stop head on. As for siege and logistics equipment, what this war produced on the record includes naval blockades at Chalcedon in Bithynia and at Sinope in Pontus, pontoon bridges carried across the Euphrates, and the marching camp of the Roman legion, with mule trains for the baggage; and those very mules became the standing target of Mithridates' light cavalry.
tactics: 盧庫路斯的戰術核心不是奇襲而是韌性。他要求軍隊每日行軍約三十羅馬里，列隊極窄，以免行軍縱隊在山道與隘口被截斷，逐夜築營、掘壕立柵，營區的樣子本身便是一支羅馬軍隊的樣子。前73年進入卡帕多細亞後，他放棄地中海而走內陸，把後勤線拉成一條從辛諾佩、阿米蘇斯等港口北運的長鏈；這條鏈條後來被米特拉達梯的游騎隊切斷過無數次，而卡帕多細亞無海可通、糧秣全靠陸運，正是盧庫路斯最吃力的地方，也是他把戰爭拖成長征的原因。提格拉諾刻達之戰是全役最見兵法的會戰：面對數量遠勝己方的亞美尼亞與斯基泰聯軍，盧庫路斯選在己方可以倚託的丘陵與溪谷一線布陣，迫使梯格拉斯的龐大步兵無法展開，只得讓上萬騎兵在狹窄地形裡擠成一團；羅馬重步兵穩住正面，色雷斯與高盧騎兵守住兩翼，關鍵一刻羅馬預備騎兵反衝，把擠在一起的聯軍衝散，戰局從此倒向羅馬。追擊階段，盧庫路斯帶著同一支疲兵越過阿拉克塞斯河，繞行高加索南麓，在嚴冬中強行行軍，士卒因寒冷與缺糧大量減員；到前68年攻下阿爾塔克薩塔時，這支部隊已與出發時大不相同。澤拉之戰則是野戰與政治的合流：對手陣中出現了倒戈的王子，梯格拉斯的騎兵隨即潰散。米特拉達梯自己的戰術是游擊與焦土，避開正面決戰，以輕騎襲擊羅馬穆勒隊與糧道，在辛諾佩、卡比拉一帶以城塞與海路彆住羅馬，再用希臘雇傭兵方陣做最後一搏。羅馬在這一役中的另一種戰術是政治戰：拉攏卡帕多細亞，誘使本都方面的舊友倒戈，迫使亞美尼亞與龐提翁分離。
tacticsEn: The core of Lucullus's method was endurance rather than surprise. He required the army to march about thirty Roman miles a day and to keep its column so narrow that the marching order could not be cut off on mountain tracks and defiles, and he had the camp built and the ditch dug and the palisade set every night, so that the appearance of the camp was itself the appearance of a Roman army. After entering Cappadocia in 73 BC he turned his back on the Mediterranean and marched inland, stretching his supply into a long chain carried north from the ports of Sinope and Amisus; that chain was cut again and again by Mithridates' raiding cavalry, and since Cappadocia has no outlet to the sea and grain had to come entirely overland, this was the weakest point in Lucullus's position and the reason he turned the war into a long march. The battle of Tigranocerta was the one engagement in the war that showed the art of war most plainly. Facing an Armenian and Scythian coalition far outnumbered by him, Lucullus chose his ground along hills and a watercourse that he could rely upon, so that Tigranes' enormous infantry could not deploy and could only let tens of thousands of horsemen be compressed into a mass in the narrow ground; the Roman heavy infantry held the front, Thracian and Galatian cavalry covered the flanks, and at the critical moment the Roman reserve cavalry charged back into the compressed mass and broke it, and from that point the battle was Roman. In the pursuit Lucullus took the same exhausted army across the Araxes and around the southern flank of the Caucasus, forcing the march in the depth of winter, and the men were thinned by cold and lack of food; by the time Artaxata fell in 68 BC the force was nothing like the one that had set out. The battle of Zela was a meeting of field combat and politics: a prince appeared in the opposing line who had come over to Lucullus, and Tigranes' cavalry broke up on the spot. Mithridates' own method was harassment and scorched earth. He avoided pitched battle, sent light cavalry against the Roman mule trains and supply lines, held the Romans at Sinope and Cabira with his fortresses and his sea routes, and kept the Greek mercenary phalanx in reserve for a final effort. The other Roman tactic in this war was political: courting Cappadocia, enticing old friends of Pontus to come over, and driving a wedge between Armenia and Pontus.
data: 可以引用的數字大致如下。戰爭自公元前74年開打，到前63年龐培接管、梯格拉斯出降，前後約十一年，是羅馬在東方最長的一次戰役。提格拉諾刻達之戰前，普魯塔克《盧庫路斯傳》記盧庫路斯麾下約一萬五千步兵與二千五百騎兵，而亞美尼亞方面的聯軍在各家記載中自數萬至十萬不等，騎兵以萬計，羅馬是以縱深換數量。行軍速率是盧庫路斯最常被引用的數字：每日約三十羅馬里，一羅馬里約合一點四八公里，即日行四十餘公里。卡帕多細亞的兩座大城相距約三百公里：提格拉諾刻達在幼發拉底河與博赫坦河匯流之處，阿爾塔克薩塔在阿拉克塞斯河谷。軍團編制上，每中隊約八百人，一軍團十中隊，理論上滿員約四五千人；前63年執政官弗拉庫斯以「芬布里」之名徵召兩支部隊，這批西米里戰爭的老兵被視為全軍最精銳的一支。冬季追擊的減員沒有確數，普魯塔克只說大批士卒凍斃於雪中。收束的日期則有明確記載：公元前63年，梯格拉斯向龐培投降並被押往羅馬，龐培於前61年以「解放亞美尼亞」的名號迎接他；同年米特拉達梯逃往博斯波魯斯，在那裡被迫自盡。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly these. The war began in 74 BC and ended in 63 BC with Pompey taking over and Tigranes surrendering, a matter of roughly eleven years, and it was the longest campaign Rome ever fought in the east. Before the battle of Tigranocerta, Plutarch's Life of Lucullus gives Lucullus about fifteen thousand foot and two thousand five hundred horse, while the Armenian coalition is put by different authors at anywhere from tens of thousands to a hundred thousand with cavalry in the thousands; Rome was trading numbers for depth. The marching rate is the number most often quoted for Lucullus, about thirty Roman miles a day, a Roman mile being about one and a half kilometres, that is upwards of forty kilometres a day. The two great cities of Cappadocia lie about three hundred kilometres apart: Tigranocerta stands where the Tigris joins the Bohtan, while Artaxata lies in the valley of the Araxes. In the organisation of the legion, a cohort numbered about eight hundred men and a legion ten cohorts, giving a paper strength of roughly four to five thousand; in 63 BC the consul Flaccus raised two units known as the Fimbri, veterans of the Cimbrian war who were regarded as the finest soldiers in the Roman army. There is no exact figure for the losses of the winter pursuit; Plutarch says only that a great many men were frozen to death in the snow. The closing of the war, by contrast, is precisely dated: in 63 BC Tigranes surrendered to Pompey and was brought to Rome, where Pompey received him in 61 BC with the title of the liberator of Armenia; in the same year Mithridates fled to the Bosporus and was forced to kill himself there.
cause: 最深的原因是兩套擴張體系在東地中海與黑海沿岸撞上了。公元前1世紀初，龐提翁在蘇拉的支持下成為黑海東岸的強國，但蘇拉於前88至前84年接連打擊龐提翁，前83年龐提翁還一度攻入小亞細亞，佔領以弗所為首的愛奧尼亞城邑，蘇拉的反擊以屠城與掠奪回敬，把龐提翁的版圖重新拆散。米特拉達梯六世在流亡之後重建王國，接納被羅馬逐出的希臘城邦僑民，重建黑海海運，並在都城辛諾佩設立鑄幣廠充實軍費；與此同時，羅馬在比提尼亞、帕夫拉弗尼亞與卡帕多細亞扶植傀儡，切斷龐提翁的陸路，這是根本衝突。亞美尼亞王梯格拉斯在本土政治上失勢之後投靠米特拉達梯，甚至把龐提翁都城中的羅馬商人驅逐出境，兩國從此合流；前71年梯格拉斯又西進敘利亞與腓尼基，直接碰到羅馬的東地中海秩序，前74年米特拉達梯藉口比提尼亞遭到羅馬侵擾，率軍越過哈里斯河進入比提尼亞行省，逐走羅馬地方官員，未遇大抵抗便佔領大片土地，第三次米特拉達梯戰爭便由此爆發。
causeEn: At the deepest level the cause was the collision of two systems of expansion on the eastern Mediterranean and the shores of the Black Sea. At the beginning of the first century BC Pontus had become a strong state on the eastern Black Sea with Sulla's backing, but Sulla struck at it repeatedly between 88 and 84 BC; in 83 BC Mithridates even carried the war into Asia Minor and occupied the Ionian cities led by Ephesus, and Sulla's counter-stroke answered with slaughter and plunder, breaking up the Pontic realm again. After his exile Mithridates VI rebuilt the kingdom, took in the Greek civic exiles driven out by Rome, restored Black Sea shipping and set up a mint at the capital Sinope to fund his army. At the same time Rome planted clients in Bithynia, Paphlagonia and Cappadocia and cut the land routes of Pontus, and that was the fundamental conflict. After losing his footing in his own kingdom Tigranes of Armenia went over to Mithridates, even driving the Roman merchants out of the Pontic capital, and the two kingdoms were merged; in 71 BC Tigranes marched west into Syria and Phoenicia and came up directly against the Roman order in the eastern Mediterranean. In 74 BC Mithridates used the claim that Bithynia was being interfered with by Rome as his pretext, crossed the Halys into the province of Bithynia, drove out the Roman officials, and occupied a great stretch of country with little resistance, and out of this the Third Mithridatic War began.
impact: 戰爭的收穫幾乎全歸羅馬。米特拉達梯失去比提尼亞、科爾基斯、博斯波魯斯與龐提翁以外的全部領地，本都只剩下一個以辛諾佩為中心的殘餘王國，還得向羅馬繳納貢賦並交出艦隊；前63年比提尼亞與龐提翁合併為羅馬行省，奇里乞亞也在前64年淪為行省，卡帕多細亞則淪為羅馬的附庸，其王位由羅馬欽定。亞美尼亞以梯格拉斯為亞美尼亞之王的虛名接受龐培重劃的秩序，龐培把這場勝利做成公開的榮耀，並致信梯格拉斯自稱亞美尼亞的解放者，讓羅馬的權威第一次出現在幼發拉底河上游。對羅馬內部而言，龐培靠這場戰爭累積的軍功與財富回到羅馬，先後兩度出任執政官，並於前60年與凱撒、克拉蘇結盟，開啟前三頭同盟的十年，間接造成前59年凱撒在高盧取得軍權的結果，是羅馬共和末期最要命的轉折之一。軍隊帶回來的問題同樣棘手：前63年弗拉庫斯所部的芬布里在龐培接管後嘩變，攻城掠地直到以弗所，劫掠之後又把居民當作奴隸出售，羅馬元老院為此大為震動。另一面的後果是關於毒藥與暗殺的想像力：密特里達梯之毒的傳說在羅馬流傳，羅馬城邦之間的互信因此降到冰點。
impactEn: Almost the whole of the war's profit went to Rome. Mithridates lost Bithynia, Colchis, the Bosporus and every territory outside Pontus; what remained of his kingdom was a rump state centred on Sinope, paying tribute to Rome and handing over its fleet. In 63 BC Bithynia and Pontus were combined into a Roman province, Cilicia became a province in 64 BC, and Cappadocia was reduced to a Roman client state whose king was appointed by Rome. Armenia accepted the new order that Pompey redrew, with Tigranes wearing the empty title of king of Armenia, and Pompey made his victory a public celebration and wrote to Tigranes as the liberator of Armenia, so that Roman authority appeared for the first time on the upper Euphrates. Inside Rome itself, the military glory and the money Pompey brought back from this war carried him back to the city and twice to the consulship, and in 60 BC he allied with Caesar and Crassus in what became the First Triumvirate, which indirectly produced Caesar's command in Gaul in 59 BC and so one of the gravest turning points of the late Republic. The problems the armies brought home were just as awkward: the Fimbri raised by Flaccus mutinied after Pompey took over in 63 BC, sacked their way as far as Ephesus, and then sold the inhabitants as slaves, and the Senate was badly shaken by it. On the other side the war left its mark on the imagination of poison and assassination: the legend of Mithridates' poison circulated in Rome, and the trust between the communities of the city sank to freezing point.
result: 結果分三段看。公元前69年九月，提格拉諾刻達之戰後，盧庫路斯進入梯格拉斯自己焚燒過的城，奪得大量銀錢與宮室器物；前68年他攻下阿爾塔克薩塔，前67年在澤拉擊潰梯格拉斯最後的騎兵，卻在回師途中被元老院召回，龐培接手東戰線。龐培的辦法更簡單也更有效：他不再追求攻城，而是一路封鎖港口、奪取船隻、切斷米特拉達梯的財政，同時把梯格拉斯從亞美尼亞的靠山變成羅馬的附庸，前63年梯格拉斯本人出現在龐培面前投降，亞美尼亞的戰局就此結束；同年米特拉達梯逃往博斯波魯斯，在其子馬哈瑞斯的促使下自盡，龐提翁的海上帝國終結。羅馬得到的收穫是：黑海東岸的龐提翁降為行省與附庸，敘利亞與美索不達米亞的邊界線被重新劃定，羅馬的邊界第一次從地中海深入兩河之間。卡面上的羅馬重步兵在這一役的位置也因此清楚：真正決定戰局的，是那支能連續行軍、能逐夜設營、能靠海運補回兵員的重裝步兵核心，以及它的補給線；盧庫路斯輸在身處內陸而無海路可依，龐培贏在把羅馬的戰爭機器與地中海的港口重新接上。
resultEn: The outcome is best read in three stages. In September 69 BC, after the battle of Tigranocerta, Lucullus entered a city that Tigranes himself had set on fire and took a great deal of silver and treasure from the royal quarters; in 68 BC he took Artaxata, and in 67 BC he broke Tigranes' last cavalry at Zela, only to be recalled by the Senate while on his way back and handed over the eastern command to Pompey. Pompey's method was simpler and more effective. He did not chase sieges; he blockaded the ports, took the shipping, and cut Mithridates' revenues, while turning Tigranes from Armenia's patron into a Roman client, and in 63 BC Tigranes appeared before Pompey and surrendered, which ended the Armenian war. In the same year Mithridates fled to the Bosporus and was driven to kill himself there at the urging of his son Machares, and the sea empire of Pontus came to an end. What Rome gained was this: Pontus on the eastern Black Sea reduced to a province and a client, the frontier between Syria and Mesopotamia redrawn, and the boundary of Rome pushed for the first time from the Mediterranean deep into the land between the two rivers. The place of the Roman legionary on the card in this war is therefore clear. What decided the war was the heavy infantry core able to march day after day, to pitch its camp every night and to have its numbers made good by sea transport, and above all its line of supply. Lucullus lost because he was inland with no road to the sea; Pompey won because he reconnected the Roman war machine to the ports of the Mediterranean.
